⌁OBELISK COMPANION
ANDROID · ON-DEVICE
A careful companion for your next run

Mine smarter.
Keep the game yours.

An unofficial Android helper for Idle Obelisk Miner. It reads only the visible game screen, helps collect Freebie Packs, and estimates a prestige window from your measured progress.

PRIVACY-FIRST CONNECTION

Your screen stays on your device.

On-device OCR observes the game only while it is foregrounded. Screenshots stay in private app storage; no game files are modified and no screen data is uploaded.

◉ Accessibility access is opt-in
Automation

You stay in control

Automation is optional and disabled until you choose to enable it.

Freebie Pack helperScheduled scan and claim flow
Prestige automationRequires separate safety calibration
Manual modeAdvice only; never confirms prestige
Prestige confirmation can reset game progress. Manual mode is on by default.

Prestige strategy

Timing based on your run

The advisor compares current prestige points per hour with a near-term estimate, using your observed level-up times to account for slowing progress.

↗
Measured efficiency, not hidden XPNeeds at least three observed level-ups after level 20
A thoughtful recommendation

Estimate, then decide

This is guidance—not a promise of an optimal run. Screen recognition and fixed tap coordinates can be inaccurate when language, orientation, or game version changes.

Device testing with the game installed is required before enabling any automatic actions.
